description: Deterministic construction of a v8 manifest fragment from a fixture's `local`/`incoming` spec. A record names only what the case varies; everything else is the default below, so a harness builds byte-identical manifests on every run.
ids: A symbolic key ("W-A") maps through the fixture's `ids` to its canonical UUID, written uppercase on iOS-shaped manifests and lowercase on Android-shaped ones (both platforms read either). Any other id ("mA", "annA", "x1", "q1", "s1") is UUIDv5(namespace 6b0b8f0e-6a4c-4a45-9c1c-9e6f1f2d7a10, fixture id + "/" + name).

manifest.omitKeys: keys listed here are not written at all; the string value "<absent>" on a key does the same

work.title: T
work.author: A
work.epubPreservationStatusRaw: notPreserved unless harness.preserved says true, then preserved

queue.name: Later
queue.dateUpdated: = max of its memberships' lastModifiedAt, else dateCreated

tombstone.signature: valid Ed25519 over the iOS payload (TS:48-65) by the key named in harness.trust when signatureValid, else 64 zero bytes

assets: A work naming `epub: <digest>` gets `Works/<UUID>.epub` whose bytes are the harness.assetBytes entry (a minimal valid EPUB package of the stated size whose SHA-256 is recorded as the digest label); a work naming none gets no file and hasEPUB false.
expectedNormalization: Compare normalized records: work key, lifecycle (live|deleted|absent), deadline = opClock + 90 d for a locally started countdown, epub digest label, membership rows by (queue, work) with their ids/ranks, annotation rows by id with live/softDeleted/hardDeleted/hidden, a generated parked sibling matched by provenance and note text, tombstones minted by (type, record, reason).

signing.payload: TombstoneSigning.payload: type, ao3 id, canonical URL, recordID lowercase, createdAt to whole seconds, signer public key, joined by \n
signing.timestamps: every date in a fixture is an explicit ISO-8601 UTC instant with whole seconds unless stated

assetBytesRule.summary: Entire file bytes are fixed by this rule; the digest label L only names the file.
assetBytesRule.content.opf: <?xml version="1.0"?>\n<package xmlns="http://www.idpf.org/2007/opf" version="3.0" unique-identifier="id"><metadata xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:identifier id="id">urn:kudos-fixture:<L></dc:identifier><dc:title><L></dc:title><dc:language>en</dc:language></metadata><manifest><item id="c1" href="ch1.xhtml" media-type="application/xhtml+xml"/></manifest><spine><itemref idref="c1"/></spine></package>\n
assetBytesRule.ch1.xhtml: \n where is the lowercase hex of SHA-256("kudos-fixture-epub/"+L) repeated and truncated so that the whole ZIP file has exactly the stated size
assetBytesRule.zip: entries in the order above; method 0 (stored); general-purpose flags 0; version needed 20; DOS time 0x0000 and date 0x0021 (1980-01-01); no extra fields, no comments, no data descriptors; classic (non-ZIP64) records; CRC-32 and sizes in the local headers; central directory in the same order
assetBytesRule.digest: SHA-256 of the file bytes; recorded as epubDigest when the case says so

canonicalKeyInterpretation.lastModifiedAt: ISO-8601 with fractional seconds written, whole-second also accepted
canonicalKeyInterpretation.isDeleted: isDeleted true plus deletedAt; schedule only if named
canonicalKeyInterpretation.omitKeys: top-level manifest keys not written at all
canonicalKeyInterpretation.<absent>: same as omitKeys for that key

sessions: a readingSession record names {id, work}; defaults per `defaults.readingSession`; workID is ids[work]; its id is UUIDv5(namespace, fixtureId + "/" + name)
clockHooks: harness must supply: iOS archivedDeletionState(now:), clampedArchiveDate(now:) and the resurrection test now (KB:5884-5887); Android a patched restoredDeletionState(now) (none today, BMap:98-107) and merge(now:) (BMS:46). A harness without the Android seam cannot run the Android column of a1/a2/c1.
